findings.title: enable_depth_rendering API calling convention is wrong (§2.2, §2.3)
findings.description: Design uses enable_depth_rendering(True/False) but MuJoCo Python API has parameterless enable_depth_rendering() and disable_depth_rendering(). Passing True raises TypeError.
findings.fix: Replace enable_depth_rendering(True) with enable_depth_rendering() and enable_depth_rendering(False) with disable_depth_rendering() at all four call sites.

findings.title: pixel_center tuple ordering is ambiguous and inconsistent with unprojection (§2.3, §2.4)
findings.description: Detection docstring says pixel_center is (row, col) but OpenCV moments produce (cx=col, cy=row). Without explicit construction code, implementer may store (col, row), causing swapped X/Y in the §2.4 unprojection.
findings.fix: Add explicit pixel_center=(cy, cx) in detector construction to match (row, col) docstring. Show row, col = detection.pixel_center in §2.4 unprojection.

findings.title: Depth linearization heuristic fragile for close-up cameras (§2.2)
findings.description: raw.max() <= 1.0 check fails when MuJoCo returns linearized depth and all geometry is within 1.0m.
findings.fix: Add a comment documenting the heuristic assumes camera distance >= 1.0m.

findings.title: render() buffer reuse risk not addressed (§2.3)
findings.description: MuJoCo Renderer.render() may return a view of an internal buffer. perceive() renders RGB then depth sequentially without copying.
findings.fix: Add .copy() to the RGB render call in perceive(): image = self._renderer.render().copy()

findings.title: Runner frame recording placement within while loop is ambiguous (§2.5)
findings.description: Code snippet layout makes it unclear whether frame recording is per-step (inside while loop) or post-loop.
findings.fix: Add note: frame recording block goes inside the while loop, after the existing trajectory.record_step() call.

findings.title: PerceptionPolicy constructor failure leaves finally calling close() on unwrapped policy (§2.5)
findings.description: If PerceptionPolicy(policy, sim) raises, policy still points to the original Policy which has no close(). The finally block calls policy.close() → AttributeError.
findings.fix: Use a perception_active flag set after successful wrapping; check it in the finally block.

findings.title: MjvOption argument omitted from update_scene() calls (§2.2, §2.3)
findings.description: Design shows update_scene(data, camera) with two args. Existing code passes an MjvOption() as the third argument. While optional, the omission is inconsistent with the existing codebase.
findings.fix: Add MjvOption() to the constructor and pass it to update_scene(), or note that default scene options are sufficient.
